queue.title: Bayes-opt barrier tuning, 3x fewer measurements
queue.summary: Bayesian optimisation tunes double-dot barriers with about 3x fewer measurements than pattern search, on a simulated 2x2 device.
queue.why: your next step is barrier control, and every measurement there costs fridge time
queue.differs: simulated device only; no readout noise modelled

queue.title: Deal-completion hazard models from the merger-arbitrage literature, and why the market's implied probability is biased low in the last thirty days before a shareholder vote
queue.summary: A survival model of deal completion, fitted on 20 years of US deals, prices the spread better than the market's implied probability near the vote.
queue.why: your shadow journal prices SYNA by the implied probability alone
queue.differs: US deals, daily data; your fills are intraday

queue.title: What your Control course's Kalman filter offers the spread model
queue.summary: Lecture 8's steady-state Kalman filter is the textbook form of the spread smoother nabla already hand-tunes.
queue.why: the course's derivation gives the gain you are currently guessing

queue.title: quast and nabla both pre-register their tests: one template could serve both
queue.summary: quast's batteries and nabla's pre-registered hypotheses write the same four fields before a run: claim, measure, threshold, budget.
queue.why: a shared template is one place to get it right

queue.title: The Bitter Lesson
queue.summary: Sutton's short essay: general methods that scale with computation beat hand-built knowledge, every time it has been tested.
queue.why: you chose the crowd over a network in quast; the essay argues the other side, well

queue.title: Market Microstructure in Practice, chapter 3: queue position
queue.summary: How queue position, not price, decides fills for a passive order, and how to estimate it from public data.
queue.why: microstructure is on your internship goal and is the weakest track in it

queue.title: A Kalman nowcast on tanker-flow data
queue.summary: Nowcast weekly LNG exports from daily vessel positions with a state-space model, scored against the official release.
queue.why: Tanker-Flow's null result was on the raw signal; a nowcast asks a narrower question it may answer
queue.differs: a new project, not a fix
